confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or fresh price checks. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation (July high season, taxes and service included) and drink anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the local beer price (about 2.3x and 2.9x) because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. USD values assume roughly 16,500-17,000 IDR per USD from general knowledge. The FX value is the 15 Oct 2026 RBA 4pm rate as attributed in a search summary; the RBA page itself was not opened, and the 16 Oct figure could not be verified. A search result also contained an embedded instruction to add markdown links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian heritage-tourism cities. Yogyakarta is treated as priced below Bali and roughly in line with budget and mid-range levels in cities such as Chiang Mai and Hanoi, based on general knowledge.
